verdict.rationale: Helicone offers event-driven background automation. Webhooks fire when LLM requests complete, can be filtered by properties, and are meant to automate workflows and score responses. Alerts monitor error rates and costs, and reports come with paid plans. However, the actual automation logic has to live in external systems the user builds, and nothing shows user-defined autonomous jobs or agents running inside Helicone. Missing for 10: native scheduled/recurring automations, a built-in workflow or agent builder that executes actions autonomously, and hands-on or independent corroboration of webhook/alert automations.
